hook: Your car's back glass has wires baked right into it.
title: Your Car's Back Glass Has Hidden Wires
description:
The thin lines across your car's rear windshield are heating wires. Press the rear defogger button and they warm up to clear fog. You can see them on the glass right now.

#Shorts #Cars #Technology
comment_prompt: Did you know this? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your car's back glass has wires baked into it.
scenes.headline: WIRES IN THE GLASS

scenes.narration: Those thin lines are not decoration.
scenes.headline: NOT DECORATION

scenes.narration: Press the rear defogger button on your dashboard.
scenes.headline: PRESS THIS BUTTON

scenes.narration: The wires warm up and the glass heats.
scenes.headline: GLASS HEATS UP

scenes.narration: Fog and mist melt away from the glass.
scenes.headline: FOG CLEARS

scenes.narration: Monsoon drivers see them clear the view.
scenes.headline: MONSOON FIX

scenes.narration: Go look at your car's back glass.
scenes.headline: GO LOOK NOW

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: a city that commutes by cable car.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW
